ONE_SENTENCE_PITCH: Generate an installable pain001 loader plugin with Cookiecutter and executable contract tests.
QUICK_START_SNIPPET:
poetry run cookiecutter . --no-input --output-dir /tmp/pain001-plugins
cd /tmp/pain001-plugins/pain001-loader-example
python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'
python -m pytest -q
pain001 plugins show example
QUICK_START_EXPLANATION: The generated parser reads tab-separated text with a header. Replace that parser for your own format while retaining the loader protocol and tests.
CAPABILITY_DESCRIPTION: Entry-point packaging, streaming loader scaffold and generated tests
FEATURES_CONTENT: Preserves leading zeroes and decimal scale, rejects malformed row widths, supports bounded streaming chunks and exposes package metadata through pain001 discovery.
CONFIGURATION_CONTENT: Cookiecutter prompts for project_name, module_name, plugin_name and file_extension. Use Python identifiers for module_name and a lowercase dotted suffix for file_extension. The package starts at 0.0.1.
EXAMPLES_CONTENT: The generated ExampleLoader and tests form the worked example. See [authoring guide](docs/usage.md) for all four core extension contracts.
LIMITATIONS_CONTENT: Do not use the demonstration parser as a bank-format specification or assume plugins are sandboxed. Plugins run with the host Python process's permissions.
SECURITY_CONTENT: Review templates and plugin code before execution. Use synthetic fixtures only. The example preserves strings; it does not infer missing identifiers or monetary data. No signing or sandbox boundary is claimed.
